title: SG-6.4.2 · Add onReject prop and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
summary: ExecutionPanel gets an optional onReject prop and a Reject button shown only while a run is AWAITING_APPROVAL
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx already renders Approve (AWAITING_APPROVAL, onApprove) and Retry (FAILED, onRetry) and has no onReject. Desired behavior: add an optional onReject prop and a Reject button visible only for AWAITING_APPROVAL when onReject is given, calling onReject with the execution id. Expected result: Approve and Retry behave exactly as before. Why: the admin must be able to reject a publication (SG-6.4).
acceptance_criteria: Given status AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject provided, when the panel renders, then a button named Reject is shown
Given Reject is clicked, when onReject runs, then it is called once with the execution id
Given onReject is not provided or status is not AWAITING_APPROVAL, when the panel renders, then no Reject button exists
Given the change, when Approve or Retry is clicked, then they call onApprove or onRetry with the id as before

in_scope: onReject prop and Reject button in ExecutionPanel
preserve: Approve and Retry visibility and behavior

definition_of_done: Reject button implemented per acceptance criteria
Unit tests for the panel pass
